string-array.name: whats_new_0_38_0
string-array.item: Your phone now checks for your children\'s messages even while it\'s asleep, so a request or an alert can\'t sit unread for hours overnight.
Web filtering now tells you when it isn\'t actually running — another VPN app taking over used to look like everything was fine.
Blocked sites are filtered using your own network\'s DNS, so Walcott no longer breaks browsing on networks that block public resolvers.
Children\'s phones now spot revoked permissions by themselves and say how to fix them, instead of waiting to be asked.
Both phones now check everything Walcott needs switched on — and each reminder\'s button opens the exact settings screen that grants it. Anything you hide stays in Settings → Device setup.
Alerts are split into two kinds, so you can silence "battery low" without silencing "the clock was changed".
You can point Walcott at your own relay server if the default one starts refusing your messages.
